title: Academy - BaSuka Energy
metaDescription: BaSuka Academy trains women as certified Yennenga Warriors — a professional workforce-development pipeline across Africa's energy ecosystem: solar PV, battery systems, site operations, health & safety, and smart-energy services.

sections.heading: Training the Yennenga Warriors
sections.body: The BaSuka Academy is BaSuka's workforce-development and community-empowerment pillar. It prepares a professional women-led talent pipeline for health and safety, site and field operations, customer and community engagement, smart-energy services, battery and storage support, and future clean-mobility activities.

sections.heading: Your path from graduate to regional lead
sections.body: Certification is a gateway, not an endpoint. BaSuka is committed to retaining and advancing every Yennenga Warrior who joins us.

sections.heading: The 8-Week Certification Program
sections.intro: Six weeks of classroom instruction followed by two weeks of supervised practice at an active Swap & Glow™ station. No prior electrical experience required.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
sections.body: At the BaSuka Academy, we believe the clean-energy transition is only as strong as the leaders who operate it.

items.q: Who can apply to the Academy?
items.a: Any motivated woman based in Africa who is interested in technology, sustainability, and community service. No prior experience in electrical engineering is required – we train from the ground up.

items.q: Is there a cost to Participate ?
items.a: Training costs are currently covered by BaSuka Energy. Further details on stipend and living support will be confirmed at the application stage.

Our goal is to assign every certified graduate to a station. Placement depends on station availability in your region, but all graduates enter our priority talent pool for new launches and supervisory roles.
Send your name, location, and a short motivation statement to basukaacademy@basukaenergy.com. We aim to respond within 7 business days.

sections.heading: Ready to Lead the Clean-energy revolution
body: Applications are open for the next cohort. Join the women building West Africa’s most trusted energy infrastructure.

sections.heading: 3 YEAR IMPACT TARGETS
sections.body: These are program goals —updated as BaSuka scales.

items.title: 1,000+ Women Trained
items.body: Our goal is to train over 1,000 women through the Academy within our first three years

items.title: Income Advancement
items.body: We aim for our graduates to earn 2–3× the local minimum wage through our performance-linked commission model

items.title: Safe Hubs
items.body: Our graduates are the reason BaSuka stations are recognized as safe, reliable “women’s places” for energy and mobility services
